note: A stack that reads the tenant's own PostgreSQL through outlet://crm/query, declared in OPS/crm-demo/OUTLETS/crm.yaml with the DSN held as the tenant secret CRM_DSN. The smoke run sets no secret, so the lookup answers 502 with txco_outlet_missing_secret — proving the declaration deployed, the scheme dispatched and the failure came back as data. See README.md to run it against a real database. Binds localhost → crm-demo (the _sys/boot/75 auto-route also exists for bare `txco dev` use).

checks.name: no secret → failure is data, not a dropped op
